specific: Please give me a specific date for the meeting.
reason: a cause or explanation for something
Nobody knew the real reason for his sudden resignation.
always: at all times; on every occasion
My grandmother always waters her plants early in the morning.
clear: easy to understand, see, or perceive; free from confusion
The instructions were clear enough for a beginner to follow.
easy: The test was easy enough that most students finished early.
change: A single ingredient can change the whole flavour of a dish.
based: having something as a foundation or starting point
The film is based on a true story from the 1980s.
milestone: an important event or stage in the development of something
Graduating from university was a major milestone in her life.
kid: The kid ran across the playground chasing a bright red ball.
really: I really enjoyed the concert despite the terrible weather.
parent: an earlier species or form from which others evolved
Scientists traced the fossil back to its likely parent species.
fit: to be the right size or shape for something
This key doesn't fit the lock on the front door.
same: They wore the same colour shirts to the reunion.
thing: an object, idea, or matter not named specifically
There's one thing I still don't understand about the plan.
grandparent: a parent of one's mother or father
Every grandparent at the reunion had a story to share.
motivates: gives someone a reason or incentive to act
thúc đẩy, tạo động lực cho
A sense of teamwork motivates volunteers to keep coming back.
engage: to take part in, attract, or involve someone in an activity
Good teachers know how to engage even the quietest students.
because: They cancelled the picnic because it started to rain.
lifestyle: the way a person or group typically lives
A healthy lifestyle includes regular exercise and balanced meals.
